author: Thomas_Shoes
body:
Sorry this is a bit late, but yesterday me and corkscrew102 were BOTH banned for ban evasion.

What happened was the moderator thought I was ban evading from my combat logging infraction.  However, as corkscrew102 (Jacob as some of you probably have talked to him by now) told me those are his alts that he uses to rush.

I am going to add the same I.P thing again in case some staff don't know: Everyone at my school (And county) has the same I.P because high schools gave labtops to everyone (https://www.arlnow.com/2014/08/27/aps-to-give-hs-freshmen-macbooks/).

As far as corkscrew102 and I being the same person, this is totally not true.  You can probably look at us playing at the same time in the past.  Michael has been in a Skype call with both of us at the same time.  And if you look back at our profiles a long time ago we were both regulars.

I don't think corkscrew's alts were breaking the rules so this appeal should apply to him as well.  If you need to question either of us farther my Skype is thomas.shoemaker8 and his is j.stowell_

Thank you!
